name: llama-copilot
description: VS Code extension that integrates llama-server LLMs as language model chat providers.

llamaCopilot.endpoints.description: Configuration for llama-server endpoints. Each key is an endpoint identifier, and models will be suffixed with @<identifier> (e.g., model-name@local)

url.description: URL of the llama-server instance (e.g., http://localhost:8013)

apiToken.description: Optional API token for authenticated endpoints

headers.description: Optional headers to add to all requests for this endpoint

requestBody.description: Optional JSON properties to merge into request body for this endpoint

thinkingBudgetFraction.description: Fraction of max_tokens to allocate to thinking (thinking_budget_tokens). Default 0.5. Values above 1 disable the thinking budget.

models.description: Per-model configuration. Each key is a model ID (without @endpoint suffix)

headers.description: Optional headers specific to this model (merged with endpoint headers, model headers take precedence)

requestBody.description: Optional JSON properties to merge into request body for this model (merged with endpoint requestBody, model properties take precedence)

contextSize.description: Override context size for this model (in tokens)

maxOutputTokens.description: Override maximum output tokens for this model

thinkingBudgetFraction.description: Fraction of max_tokens to allocate to thinking (thinking_budget_tokens). Default 0.5. Values above 1 disable the thinking budget. Overrides endpoint-level setting.

imageInput.description: Whether image input is supported by the model

toolCalling.description: Whether tool calling is supported. Can be a boolean or a number (maximum number of tools)

llamaCopilot.showAllModels.description: Show all models from llama-server without filtering. By default, models with a slash in their ID (e.g. HuggingFace repo paths) are hidden because they duplicate aliased models. Enable this if your models are not appearing.

llamaCopilot.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Request timeout in seconds for llama-server (headers and body). Increase for large contexts.

llamaCopilot.promptProgressStatusBarThre.description: Show status bar during prompt processing when estimated remaining time exceeds this many seconds. Set to 0 to disable.

llamaCopilot.minPromptProgressElapsedMs.description: Minimum milliseconds of prompt processing before showing progress.

llamaCopilot.enableCursorRules.description: Enable cursor rules tool for LLM access to project rules from .cursor/rules/

llamaCopilot.enableToolLoopDetection.description: Detect and break tool-call loops by pruning duplicate rounds and injecting a refusal.

llamaCopilot.inlineCompletionModel.description: Model ID for inline (ghost) completions in the editor (e.g. sweep-next-edit-1.5b@local). If empty, inline completions are disabled.

llamaCopilot.inlineCompletionMaxInputByt.description: Maximum total input size in bytes (UTF-8) for inline completion requests.

llamaCopilot.inlineCompletionTimeoutMs.description: Request timeout in milliseconds for inline completion requests.

llamaCopilot.inlineCompletionDebounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before sending an automatic inline completion request.

llamaCopilot.inlineCompletionIncludeCont.description: Use open tab contents to provide better inline completions.

llamaCopilot.inlineCompletionPrompt.default: Limit completion to a few words.
llamaCopilot.inlineCompletionPrompt.description: Text sent as the llama-server POST /infill "prompt" field.

llamaCopilot.debug.modelListFetch.description: Enable debug logging for model list fetch operations

llamaCopilot.debug.completion.description: Enable debug logging for completion requests

llamaCopilot.debug.tokenization.description: Enable debug logging for tokenization operations

llamaCopilot.debug.rulesMatching.description: Enable debug logging for rules matching operations

llamaCopilot.debug.toolCalls.description: Enable debug logging for tool calls

llamaCopilot.debug.inlineCompletion.description: Enable debug logging for inline completion requests

llamaCopilot.server.managed.markdownDescription: Enable managed llama-server mode. Downloads and runs llama-server automatically. Once enabled, [open the Models Manager](command:llamaCopilot.manageModels) to select which models to run.

llamaCopilot.server.port.description: Port for the managed llama-server instance.

llamaCopilot.server.stopOnDeactivate.markdownDescription: Kill the managed llama-server when VS Code closes. Set to false to keep it running between sessions. When false, the server stays alive as long as any VS Code window is open.

llamaCopilot.server.autoUpdate.description: Automatically update the llama-server binary when a new release is available.

llamaCopilot.server.extraArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to the managed llama-server.

llamaCopilot.server.manageModels.markdownDescription: Configure which models the managed server runs. [Open Models Manager ↗](command:llamaCopilot.manageModels)
